summary: Comprehensive testing of Pop Off! video chat for matched users completed. All backend APIs pass (16/16 tests). All frontend UI elements render correctly. Video chat Agora integration requires REACT_APP_AGORA_APP_ID configuration.

integration_issues.issue: Toast shows 'Video chat not configured. Please contact support.' when clicking Start Video Call - expected since REACT_APP_AGORA_APP_ID is empty
integration_issues.priority: LOW - Expected behavior when Agora not configured

backend: GET /api/matches returns list of matches with correct structure
GET /api/matches enriches matches with other_user data
GET /api/chat/{match_id} returns messages for valid match
POST /api/agora/token returns 500 when Agora not configured (expected)
Match appears in both users' matches lists
frontend: Matches page shows matched users with avatar and name
Video button (pink outline) on match card navigates to /video-call/:matchId
Chat button (gradient) on match card navigates to /chat/:matchId
Video call page shows pre-call screen with match's name and avatar
Video call page has 'Start Video Call' button
Video call page has 'Chat' button in header to switch to text chat
Chat page shows match's name with 'Active' status
Chat page has 'Video Call' button in header
Chat page has message input and send button
Route /video-call/:matchId is accessible and renders correctly
Navigation from Chat to Video Call works correctly

action_items: Configure REACT_APP_AGORA_APP_ID in frontend/.env to enable video chat functionality
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_matches_video_chat.py (created new test file for matches/video chat features)
seed_data_creation: Alice and Bob are matched with match_id: match_a5cd37d4b6c4. Additional test users created for mutual swipe testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Video chat for matched users is fully implemented. The flow is: Matches page -> Video/Chat buttons -> Video call page with pre-call screen -> Start Video Call. Video call controls (audio/video toggle, end call) are conditionally rendered after joining. Agora SDK integration requires REACT_APP_AGORA_APP_ID to be configured for actual video calls. All data-testid attributes are properly placed for UI testing.
